# nps_workshop_settings_mtls_cas (Resource)

The `nps_workshop_settings_mtls_cas` resource manages the certificate authorities Workshop trusts for mTLS authentication of Santa. Santa can sync over mTLS when `nps_workshop_settings_sync_auth` enables it and Santa's client certificate is signed by one of these CAs.

You need the `read:settings` and `write:settings` permissions.

This is a singleton resource, one per tenant, and it manages the tenant's whole CA list: every apply, including the first, adds the configured CAs and removes any others. It adds before it removes, so swapping one CA for another never leaves a moment when neither is trusted. Destroying it removes it from state and leaves the tenant's CAs as they were.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nps_workshop_settings_mtls_cas" "settings" {
  certificates_pem = [
    file("${path.module}/device-issuing-ca.pem"),
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `certificates_pem` (Set of String) PEM-encoded CA certificates, one certificate per entry. Entries are compared by certificate, so PEM formatting such as line endings doesn't plan a change. An empty set removes every CA.
